name: Register Detector
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Estimates which vocal register the singer is in: chest, mix, head, falsetto, or belt. Classifies from f0, formant-corrected H1*-H2* (Iseli-Alwan), spectral tilt (H1-A3), harmonic richness (HRF) and the singer's power ratio (SPR). Useful for training — see whether a high note actually stays in mix or slips into falsetto.
